market_view: VIX 16 after a 7.5% one-day rise, calm regime; Treasury yields rising (10-year 4.70%) with weekly losses likely. Oil rebounding on Iran sanctions threats.

oil_gas.catalyst: Reuters: 'Oil rises as Trump threatens sanctions on Iran partners'; WTI +8.1% in 5 days to 87.83 with the Hormuz risk continuing; XOM (+4.75% in 5d) still lags the crude move.
oil_gas.reasoning: Continuing Iran supply risk keeps the existing XOM long; exit if a deal is reported or crude reverses. The 10-day mark is near, so renew for another 10 days only on the live catalyst.

gold_miners.reasoning: NEM is up 35% in 20 days and the 'Why Is Newmont Stock Surging Friday?' headline restates a move already made. Yields rising is a headwind. No unpriced catalyst.

chips.reasoning: Headlines are opinion pieces and an NVIDIA technical blog, not a catalyst. Sector ETF down 4.5% in 5 days, but oversold is not a reason. Most volatile family.

pharma.reasoning: LLY guidance-raise catalyst from 2026-08-05 has run its planned hold; exit as planned after a -2.8% day. No negative news seen, but no new catalyst either.

copper_uranium.reasoning: Headlines are small-cap and project items with no FCX effect. Copper fell 0.4% yesterday; FCX +3% is a move already made. No Congo ban confirmation.

would_change_my_mind: An Iran deal or crude reversal would exit XOM; a confirmed Congo copper ban with copper rallying, or a named chip or pharma catalyst, would justify a long.

handoff.what_changed: Oil rebounded (WTI 87.83, +8.1% in 5 days) after Trump threatened sanctions on Iran partners, so the XOM long continues. LLY exited as planned. Yields still rising (10-year 4.70%); NEM surged again but remains flat for us.
